bot.title: Bot trading
bot.readOnly: Dedicated account · Internal HIVE/HBD market · Read-only monitoring
bot.configure: Enter the dedicated bot account or set VITE_BOT_ACCOUNT to open it automatically. No private key is required.
bot.pnlNote: Net HBD from fills + net HIVE from fills × current mid. Includes the period's unclosed position; deposits are not profits and prior inventory revaluation is excluded.
bot.volumeNote: Volume = buys + sells, counted once per fill. P&L applies to the selected period, not net HBD cash flow or the process's daily breaker.
bot.noOrders: This account has no open orders.
bot.noFills: No HIVE/HBD executions in the selected period.
bot.loading: Reading account balances, orders and history. Full history may take a while.
bot.refreshNote: Balances and orders every 15 seconds; execution history every 60 seconds. Displays real on-chain activity only, not virtual paper-mode orders.

errors.invalidAccount: Enter a valid Hive account name without @ or spaces.
errors.connection: Could not refresh Hive data. Retrying in 15 seconds; you can also select Refresh.
errors.invalidResponse: Hive returned incomplete or invalid data. No partial result is displayed. Retry or select a shorter period.
errors.accountNotFound: This Hive account does not exist. Check the dedicated account name.
errors.invalidBook: The order book is empty or has invalid prices. Inventory cannot be valued in HBD.
errors.historyLimit: The period exceeds 100,000 history entries. Select a shorter period; no truncated result was calculated.
